localBiteReport: Reports from the past one to two weeks indicate the inshore bite in Choctawhatchee Bay is picking up as the Destin Fishing Rodeo gets underway in October. Redfish are the most consistent bay target right now, with fish showing up in the bayous, around dock lights, and along grass edges with moving water. Speckled trout are also active — particularly at night near lit docks — though the Half Hitch Destin report contributing to this summary is approximately two weeks old (dated 9-28-26), so conditions may have shifted. The captainexperiences.com guide feed, updated within the past week, echoes that redfish and trout in the bayou are heating up alongside the fall seasonal transition. Water temperature is 82°F.
